scope: Compare one already initialized equal-or-lower-cut alternative after clearance worsens the first grid; keep its original global deadline and final image, feature, geometry and paper checks. Fixed photo crops and masks, no saved templates or manual cut counts. This record does not certify repository/browser QA.

hunodan.scope: Do not replace the full 22-case measurements with isolated repeats. Both unchanged and current engines run the same two inputs and ten-second settings in separate fresh processes. The full current run has two slightly higher recent-release errors; isolated current outputs match or improve the unchanged control. This supports wall-clock sensitivity but is not a guarantee of equal error under every load.

prototype.change: Disallow a larger grid from consuming the early comparison. It keeps its ordinary turn.
prototype.qualification: The rejected preparation spent 0.728 seconds, but other initialization stages were also slower; the comparison alone is not established as the entire cause.

visualReview.flower: Downsampled corner connections removed; small centre contour defects remain. Native reconstruction unchanged.
visualReview.photoDefects: Floral checker remains distorted; gift has border protrusions, gingerbread retains small false openings and a border connection, maple has deformed border sections, Viking has rounded contour and border changes. Candle retains the same silhouette.
visualReview.qualification: Acceptance does not establish original cutting paths, uniform visual fidelity or physical assembly.

timings.timeLimit: Requested solver search allowance, not an end-to-end latency limit.
timings.detectionSeconds: Crop detection wall time. Decoding and the source thumbnail are outside this timer.
timings.runSeconds: Each runs[].seconds starts after crop detection and source-thumbnail creation. Includes preparation, solving, validation, export, independent replay and per-case artifact writes; excludes decoding and detection.
timings.solveAndValidationSeconds: design() wall time, including final validation and generated export data. Excludes crop detection, preparation, independent replay and writing artifacts.
timings.independentReplaySeconds: Separate exported-SVG renderer wall time; not part of application solving.
timings.browser: Actual click-to-ready latency is measured separately by paint-browser-test.mjs.
